# 270_R6OPS.4 — delayed-job watchdog + account/email hardening (RH-4/17/18/19, RH-5)

## What

Handoff grouping (d) — five verified findings around the pg-boss delayed-job and account paths:

- **RH-4 + RH-17 — `account.hard-delete` had no watchdog and swallowed its enqueue.** The
  `project.purge` silent-loss class (F-R6WATCH.2-1, 260) applied verbatim: the delayed arm carried
  `.catch(() => undefined)` and a `standard`-policy queue. New hourly **`handleAccountDeleteSweep`**
  (rides the `test-tenant.purge` tick beside the tombstone sweep) re-arms any
  `deletion_requested_at` marker lacking a live `account.hard-delete` job at its own grace end;
  the api send failure now logs `FAILED`+user-id; the consumer logs before rethrow.
- **RH-18 — `singletonKey` was a prod no-op.** pg-boss 12's singleton unique indexes are
  policy-gated; every queue ran `standard`. All 15 send-keyed queues (run.start/resume/cancel/
  deliver/finalize, gate.expiry, figure.render, notify, stripe.event, ingest.sync/reconstruct/
  voice.purge, account.export, account.hard-delete, project.purge) now declare **`exclusive`**
  policy — ≤1 non-terminal job per key, the send-time dedupe the keys intend (`singleton`
  throttles `active` but still queues the dup; `stately` allows one-of-each; `short` dedupes only
  `created`). `create_queue` is `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` and `updateQueue` omits `policy`, so the
  prod flip rides **migration `0063`** (`update pgboss.queue`, `to_regclass`-guarded). The api's
  `createQueue` list also missed `account.hard-delete`/`gate.expiry`/`figure.render`/ingest queues
  — a send to a missing queue returns null, silently dropped (same class): now covered. The
  `InMemoryQueue` self-confirming-test trap is recorded (it dedupes vs ALL sends — the tests
  proved intent, never deployed behavior). Keyless sends stay `standard` (mail.send, auth.mail,
  all `boss.schedule` crons).
- **RH-19 — `account_exports` wedge.** A `building` row deduped every POST forever, incl. one
  stranded by a `queue.send` throw. `building` dedupe is now bounded by a 1 h staleness TTL
  (stale ⇒ marked `failed` `build_expired`); a send-throw fails the row (`enqueue_failed`) and
  503s — the next POST builds fresh.
- **RH-5 — email change, five arms.** 409 `email_taken` pre-check (+ `23505` TOCTOU catch at
  confirm) instead of the unique-constraint 500; old-address notices at request AND completion;
  other-session revoke on confirm (the confirming session survives); branded `Rhēma` templates
  (`renderEmailChangeVerifyEmail`/`renderEmailChangeNoticeEmail`); the verification row stores a
  SHA-256 `tokenHash` with `timingSafeEqual` compare (legacy `token` rows still confirm ≤1 h).

## Survivor/transition notes

- `voice.purge` + the test-tenant sweep's `account.hard-delete` sends are now keyed (required
  under `exclusive` — a keyless job shares the `''` singleton slot).
- Existing `standard`-stamped pending jobs keep inert keys until terminal (policy stamps at
  insert); watchdog `not exists` checks are policy-blind — no re-arm gap.
